title: lepisanthes ferruginea
intro: Lepisanthes ferruginea, commonly known as the Rusty Currant, is a plant species belonging to the family Salicaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, thanks to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Lepisanthes ferruginea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antipyretic, and analgesic properties. The plant's health benefits also include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
